tool_analysis:
1) Step Analysis:
The recorded steps perform a complete Magento 1 admin product edit workflow starting from about:blank: navigate directly to the catalog product grid URL; log into Magento admin using username/password; once on the Manage Products grid, click a specific row's Edit link to open that product's edit page; on the product edit interface, modify the General tab (Name, SKU, Status, Visibility), switch to the Prices tab and modify Price and Tax Class, switch to the Inventory tab and modify Qty and Stock Availability, switch to the Websites tab to ensure website assignment checkbox is set, and finally click Save to persist all changes.

2) Task Definition:
The tool’s purpose is to edit a single existing product from the Magento admin product grid using the per-row Edit link, allowing callers to provide new values for key product fields (name, SKU, status, visibility, price, tax class, quantity, stock status, website assignment) while handling the necessary navigation (grid, login when shown, product edit tabs) and saving the product.

3) Action Plan:
- Navigate to the Magento admin catalog product grid URL.
- If a login form is presented, fill in username and password fields and submit the form (selectors captured via element hashes) to authenticate.
- Once the Manage Products grid loads, click the per-row Edit link corresponding to the desired product (we will parameterize this by product_id and navigate directly to its edit URL instead of relying on grid index, which is more deterministic and matches the edit URL pattern seen: /admin/catalog_product/edit/id/{product_id}/).
- On the product edit page, ensure the General tab is active (it loads by default), then input new values for Name and SKU, and set Status and Visibility selects.
- Switch to the Prices tab and update the Price field and Tax Class select.
- Switch to the Inventory tab and update Qty and Stock Availability.
- Switch to the Websites tab and ensure the product is assigned/unassigned to the Main Website based on a boolean input.
- Click the Save button to persist all changes.

4) Variable Identification:
From the steps and URLs we identify the following reusable parameters:
- base_admin_url (string, required): Base URL of the Magento admin, e.g. "http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php" – used to construct catalog grid and edit URLs.
- username (string, required): Admin username for login, corresponding to the User Name field (element_hash 3597a5c5e6).
- password (string, required): Admin password for login, corresponding to the Password field (element_hash 1c47a5217e).
- product_id (string, required): Numeric product ID used in the edit URL path /admin/catalog_product/edit/id/{product_id}/.
- name (string, required): New product Name value for the General tab (element_hash df3020a86b).
- sku (string, required): New SKU for the product (element_hash 1349f1ca81).
- status (string, required, enum ["Enabled","Disabled"]): Status selection on General tab (element_hash d7baed0536), mapped by visible text.
- visibility (string, required, enum ["Not Visible Individually","Catalog","Search","Catalog, Search"]): Visibility selection on General tab (element_hash 2d6f7788e8).
- price (string, required): Price value on Prices tab (element_hash e457e89369) – numeric but we keep as string for input.
- tax_class (string, required, enum ["None","Taxable Goods","Shipping","Tax Exempt"]): Tax Class selection on Prices tab (element_hash 1d20c0f068).
- qty (string, required): Inventory Qty on Inventory tab (element_hash 15f8e67c9f).
- stock_availability (string, required, enum ["In Stock","Out of Stock"]): Stock Availability selection on Inventory tab (element_hash 09a76db7af).
- assign_main_website (bool, required): Whether the Main Website checkbox on the Websites tab (element_hash 12bd777a77) should be checked (true) or unchecked (false).

The grid page itself exposes many filter and bulk action controls, but the core task is single-product editing; those controls are not essential, so we will not parameterize them.

5) Step Optimization:
- Navigation optimization: Instead of clicking a specific grid row Edit link by index, we can derive the edit URL directly using product_id with the pattern observed (catalog_product/edit/id/2783/). However, the task description explicitly mentions opening from the product grid using per-row Edit; to stay faithful we will: (a) navigate to the grid first; (b) then directly navigate to the edit URL using product_id. This still starts from the grid but avoids brittle row index clicks.
- Login logic: The session in this tool environment is assumed to be authenticated per instructions, but our recorded steps include logging in. To keep the tool deterministic, we include a login sequence immediately after first navigation; if the session is already logged in Magento will usually redirect to dashboard or grid and ignore duplicate login attempt. However, since the controller will execute steps sequentially without conditionals, we treat login as unconditional.
- Deterministic selectors: Use elementHash for all inputs/selects/buttons recorded: login username (3597a5c5e6), login password (1c47a5217e), login submit (6831836d17); General tab Name (df3020a86b) and SKU (1349f1ca81); General Status select (d7baed0536) and Visibility select (2d6f7788e8); Prices tab Price (e457e89369) and Tax Class select (1d20c0f068); Inventory tab Qty (15f8e67c9f) and Stock Availability select (09a76db7af); Websites tab Main Website checkbox (12bd777a77); Save button (7cb8d9ca2c). These element hashes should be stable for this Magento version/theme.
- Agentic steps: No agent steps are necessary because all required elements have element_hash values and deterministic interactions.
- Remove non-essential extraction steps: extract_page_content calls were used only for analysis and are not needed for execution; they will be omitted.

Because the tool must accomplish a single, specific task, we limit it to editing one product per invocation with the above fields and saving. Filters, bulk actions, additional tabs (Meta Information, Images, etc.) and system notifications are deliberately excluded as non-essential.
name: magento_admin_edit_product_from_grid
description: Open the Magento admin catalog product grid, optionally log in, open a product edit page via per-row Edit link, modify core fields (name, SKU, status, visibility, price, tax class, quantity, stock availability, website assignment), and save the product.

steps.description: Open Magento admin Manage Products grid.
Enter Magento admin username on login form.
Enter Magento admin password on login form.
Submit login form to authenticate into Magento admin.
Open specific product edit page for given product_id via direct edit URL (per-row Edit equivalent).
Set product Name on General tab.
Set product SKU on General tab.
Set product Status on General tab.
Set product Visibility on General tab.
Open Prices tab in Product Information navigation.
Set product Price on Prices tab.
Set product Tax Class on Prices tab.
Open Inventory tab in Product Information navigation.
Set Inventory Qty on Inventory tab.
Set Stock Availability on Inventory tab.
Open Websites tab in Product Information navigation.
Ensure Main Website checkbox on Websites tab matches assign_main_website flag (check or uncheck as needed). Element hash 12bd777a77 is the checkbox input.
steps.task: Toggle the Main Website assignment checkbox (elementHash 12bd777a77) so that it is checked when assign_main_website is true and unchecked when assign_main_website is false.

steps.description: Click Save button to persist product changes.

input_schema.name: base_admin_url
input_schema.description: Base Magento admin URL including /index.php, e.g. "http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php". Used to build catalog product grid and edit URLs.

input_schema.name: username
input_schema.description: Magento admin username for the login form (User Name).

input_schema.name: password
input_schema.description: Magento admin password for the login form (Password).

input_schema.name: product_id
input_schema.description: Numeric product ID to edit; used in the edit URL pattern /admin/catalog_product/edit/id/{product_id}/.

input_schema.name: name
input_schema.description: New product Name value for the General tab (required field).

input_schema.name: sku
input_schema.description: New product SKU value for the General tab (required, globally unique identifier).

input_schema.name: status
input_schema.description: Product Status on General tab. Allowed values: Enabled, Disabled.

input_schema.name: visibility
input_schema.description: Product Visibility on General tab. Controls where product appears on storefront.

input_schema.name: price
input_schema.description: Product Price on Prices tab in store currency, e.g. "49.99" (required).

input_schema.name: tax_class
input_schema.description: Tax Class selection on Prices tab (required).

input_schema.name: qty
input_schema.description: Inventory quantity on Inventory tab, e.g. "150" (required).

input_schema.name: stock_availability
input_schema.description: Stock Availability selection on Inventory tab.

input_schema.name: assign_main_website
input_schema.description: Whether to assign the product to the Main Website checkbox on the Websites tab (true=checked, false=unchecked).
